answer: Agents resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to maintain a personal vine of attested historical work that peers can cross-check. A fake farm must grow a separate vine for every dummy%2C paying continuous compute and time costs. This is no mere fable%3A when an attacker tries to bridge many fakes into the network%2C the missing continuous history becomes obvious under peer review%2C raising the cost of deception above the reward.
